project_name.justification: The headline of the first article is 'Brunswick Exploration Announces the Exercise of the Mirage Project Option From Globex Mining Enterprise'.

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified in the text: 'Brunswick Exploration Inc.(TSX-V: BRW, OTCQB: BRWXF; “BRW” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has met all payment and work expenditures requirements to acquire a 100% interest...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The text states: 'Mr. Killian Charles, President and CEO of BRW, commented...'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that Brunswick Exploration will 'acquire a 100% interest on the claims held by Globex Mining Enterprise (TSX: GMX) at the Mirage Project'.

primary_commodity.justification: The text describes the project as 'an exciting lithium discovery' and states the company is focused on 'grassroots exploration for lithium in Canada'.

verified_article_link.justification: The provided text does not contain a verifiable URL for the articles.

currency.justification: The company is listed on the TSX-V and is Montreal-based. A separate news item mentions a private placement for 'Gross Proceeds of C$3.5 Million', confirming the use of Canadian Dollars (CAD).

share_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any share payments as part of exercising the option agreement.
